desc:
🚨 CURRENTLY IN BETA — expect bugs

⭐ "The apocalypse is here, and the truck driving business is booming." ⭐

🌎 Hit the road with up to 3 other players in an apocalyptic world.
🛡️ Find for weapons, armor, and other supplies to defend yourself from the wasteland.
🚛 Craft upgrades for your truck, find trailers to attach, and build your own base on wheels!
🚀Level up, learn new skills, unlock rare weapon skins, customize your truck, and OVERCOME THE APOCALYPSE.

🎧 Headphones highly recommended!
🤝Join our community for sneak peeks, free rewards, and fun events!
